newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco B tumbles 5.33 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Meralco B tumbles 5.33 pct in late trade.

text.p: Manila Electric Corp (Meralco) B shares shed eight pesos, or 5.33 percent, to 142 pesos in late trade Wednesday on fears the company's first half earnings may fall lower than expectations, brokers said.
"People are probably expecting that the first semester profits of the company may not be spectacular," said Joey Roxas, president at Eagle Equities Inc.
Meralco A shares also fell two pesos to 82 pesos in late trade.
Meralco president Manuel Lopez told reporters on Tuesday first half kilowatt-hour sales volume of the company rose by six percent, slightly lower than the target.
Meralco's class B share was among the top ten most actively traded issues in late trade.
